name: TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping
author: TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping

sections.description:
The TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping plugin is a powerful solution for WooCommerce retailers who want to source, import, and sell high-quality products from verified U.S.-based dropshipping suppliers. This plugin works seamlessly with the TopDawg platform, giving you access to 500,000+ wholesale products for WooCommerce retailers, including home goods, pet supplies, apparel, electronics, and more—without managing inventory or shipping.

This plugin is ideal for WooCommerce stores that have integrated with TopDawg and want full automation, real-time syncing, and fast U.S. order fulfillment.

👉 Learn more about our WooCommerce Dropshipping Integration and Plugin.

Key Benefits

  • Access 500,000+ Wholesale Products
    Instantly source items from verified American suppliers. Browse and import products directly from TopDawg’s catalog of wholesale products for WooCommerce retailers.

  • One-Click Product Import & Auto-Sync
    Import products with a single click. The plugin automatically syncs titles, descriptions, pricing, stock levels, and images—saving time and eliminating manual work.

  • Fast Shipping From Verified U.S. Suppliers
    TopDawg provides access to U.S.-based dropshipping suppliers offering reliable 2–5 day delivery via USPS, UPS, and FedEx.

  • Real-Time Inventory Updates
    Your WooCommerce store stays updated automatically, helping prevent overselling and customer disappointment.

  • Fully Automated Order Fulfillment
    Orders are routed directly to U.S. warehouses and shipped to your customers with no manual intervention.

  • Automated Tracking Sync
    Tracking numbers are pushed back to WooCommerce so your customers always know the status of their shipment.

  • Smart Automation Tools
    Includes real-time shipping rate calculations, automated order status updates, and product media cleanup tools.

Plugin Features

  • Media Sync & Cleanup
    Keeps your WordPress Media Library clean by preventing duplicate or unused product images.

  • Live Shipping Rates at Checkout
    Displays accurate shipping costs for TopDawg items using real-time quotes from U.S. suppliers.

  • Real-Time Order & Fulfillment Updates
    WooCommerce order pages show the most current fulfillment status, shipping progress, and tracking information.

  • Seamless Product Data Management
    Products synced from TopDawg include variations, attributes, images, titles, and descriptions—automatically updated as suppliers make changes.

These features ensure your store remains organized, your customers are informed, and your order fulfillment is seamless.

How to Integrate Your WooCommerce Store

The plugin works automatically once your WooCommerce store is connected to TopDawg. You can integrate using either method below:

Option 1 — Install the Plugin

  1. Install and manually activate the TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping plugin in WordPress.
  2. After activation, follow the on-screen prompt to connect your store.
  3. Log in or create a TopDawg account and complete the integration process.

Option 2 — Connect Through TopDawg

  1. Visit the WooCommerce dropshipping suppliers integration page.
  2. Sign up or log in to your TopDawg account.
  3. Connect your WooCommerce store from the reseller dashboard.

Once connected, your store will automatically begin syncing TopDawg products, pricing, inventory, and orders.

Security and Privacy

The plugin communicates securely with the TopDawg Wholesale Platform using industry-standard encryption.

Data Shared

Only essential data is transmitted:

  • Store identifiers
  • Product synchronization updates
  • Order information required for fulfillment

No sensitive customer payment data is ever transmitted.

Authentication

Inbound requests are authenticated using a secure shared secret, used exclusively for verifying HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

This shared secret:

  • Cannot be accessed or modified by users
  • Never exposes customer or reseller credentials
  • Ensures trusted communication between WooCommerce and TopDawg

For more details, review the TopDawg Privacy Policy and TopDawg Terms of Use.

Support & Contact

For technical assistance, integration guidance, or plugin troubleshooting:

  • Visit the official TopDawg Support Page
  • Or contact our support team directly through your TopDawg reseller dashboard.

We’re here to help you connect your WooCommerce store to TopDawg quickly, securely, and successfully.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping.
  3. Click Install and then Activate.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect your WooCommerce store with TopDawg.

Manual Installation (optional)

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the extracted topdawg-wholesale-dropshipping folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Go to Plugins in your WordPress dashboard and click Activate.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect your store with TopDawg.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with all WooCommerce stores?

No. This plugin is exclusively for WooCommerce stores that have been integrated with the TopDawg platform. You must connect your store to TopDawg before product syncing, order routing, and automation features will work.

How do I integrate my WooCommerce store with TopDawg?

  1. Via the plugin — After installation, a prompt will guide you through connecting your WooCommerce store to your TopDawg account.
  2. Via the website — Visit the TopDawg WooCommerce Integration page to create an account and link your store manually.
    Once connected, syncing begins automatically.

Can I use the plugin without a TopDawg account?

No. A TopDawg reseller account is required to use the plugin. Without an account, you will not be able to import products, sync inventory, or process orders.

Will this plugin affect my existing WooCommerce products?

No. The plugin only manages TopDawg products. Your non-TopDawg products, inventory, descriptions, and images remain untouched.

Do I need to store any inventory?

No. TopDawg is a U.S.-based dropshipping supplier network, so all products are shipped directly from verified American warehouses to your customers.

How often does inventory sync?

TopDawg provides real-time inventory updates, ensuring stock levels for TopDawg products remain accurate and preventing overselling.

Are shipping rates calculated automatically?

Yes. The plugin provides real-time shipping rates for TopDawg products during checkout based on the customer’s location and the supplier’s warehouse location.

Does the plugin support automated order fulfillment?

Yes. Orders placed in your WooCommerce store are automatically routed to TopDawg’s U.S. suppliers for fulfillment. Tracking numbers and order status updates are synced back to WooCommerce automatically.

What happens to product images in my Media Library?

The plugin includes a media sync & cleanup feature that prevents duplicate or unused TopDawg product images from cluttering your WordPress Media Library.

Can I edit TopDawg product titles, descriptions, or pricing after import?

Yes. You can customize product details inside WooCommerce, but note that some synced attributes (like inventory and cost) will continue updating automatically from TopDawg.

Does the plugin support variable products or product variations?

Yes. TopDawg product variations—including size, color, and style options—sync directly to your WooCommerce store and remain updated.

Is this plugin compatible with other WooCommerce themes or plugins?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with standard WooCommerce themes and most third-party extensions. Conflicts are rare, but if you experience any issues, our support team can help.

Does the plugin sync tracking numbers to customers automatically?

Yes. Once a supplier ships an order, tracking details are automatically sent back to WooCommerce and included in customer notifications.

Is there a cost to use the TopDawg plugin?

The plugin itself is free, but a TopDawg membership plan is required to access wholesale pricing, product imports, automation, and fulfillment services.

Where can I get support if I have issues?

You can contact our support team directly through your TopDawg reseller dashboard or visit the official TopDawg Support Page for guides and troubleshooting help.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Updated readme.txt content for improved clarity, SEO, and WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Added refined plugin descriptions and metadata to enhance search visibility.
  • No functional changes to the plugin code.

1.1.1

  • Added automatic cleanup of stored API credentials during plugin deactivation or deletion.
  • Ensures WooCommerce/WordPress no longer holds TopDawg API tokens after deactivation.
  • Prevents any further syncing with TopDawg after the plugin is removed.

1.1.0

  • Updated plugin compatibility for WordPress 6.9.
  • Improved stability for WooCommerce product syncing and order routing.
  • Minor performance enhancements and code cleanup.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Access to 500,000+ U.S. products, live shipping rates, media sync, automated order fulfillment, and real-time inventory updates.
